chat.title: AI setup
chat.emptyTitle: Let us set up tracking together
chat.emptyText: Tell me about your website or pick a starting point. I ask one question at a time, prepare drafts and never publish without your confirmation.
starters: Start the setup for my site
chat.placeholder: Describe your site, paste a public pixel id or ask a question…
chat.failed: The assistant is not reachable right now. Your progress is saved.
chat.notConfigured: The AI assistant is not configured for this environment. Use the guided form instead.
chat.sidePanelText: Watch events arrive and deliveries succeed while you configure.

wizard.aiUnavailable: The AI assistant is unavailable; this guided form uses the same checks and drafts.
wizard.businessTitle: What kind of website is it?
wizard.platformText: We can detect it from public signals; you confirm.
wizard.installText: Paste the snippet from the site page, then check the installation and verify the domain.
wizard.consentText: Which CMP or consent signal does the site use? Strict opt-in stays the default.
wizard.destText: Add a destination, enter public ids, store secrets securely.
wizard.destCreated: Destination created. Enter its public id and credentials below.
wizard.planText: Proposes the standard events for your business type into the draft.
wizard.testText: Sends a flagged test event through the real pipeline.
wizard.publishText: Lint, diff and recipients are shown before you confirm. Nothing goes live without your click.
wizard.healthText: Your configuration is live. Run diagnostics any time.
wizard.checked: Check completed. See the result above.
wizard.tested: Test event sent. Check the event debugger for delivery status.
